The '''Statue of Karagga the Unyielding''' was a solid gold statue commemorating [[Karagga]] the Unyielding, the [[Supreme Mogul]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], that was located in [[Lucent Square]] on the [[Promenade]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Crafted from solid gold by no less than eighty-three artisans, the statue was commissioned by the Hutt Cartel as a gift to Karagga on his 800th birthday, and revelers gathered around the statue each year to honor his birthday. The statue was criticized by some about its lack of accuracy in reflecting Karagga's appearance.

==Behind the scenes==
The statue first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the Codex of which states that it is crafted from gold. However, the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' states that it was made from [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]].
